#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cmath>

int main() {
    int n, B;
    std::cin >> n >> B;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
    }
    int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    std::priority_queue<int, std::vector<int>, std::greater<int>> queue;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++evenCount;
        } else {
            ++oddCount;
        }
        if (evenCount == oddCount && i < n - 1) {
            queue.push(std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
        }
    }
    int sum = 0, countPairs = 0;
    while (!queue.empty() && sum + queue.top() <= B) {
        sum += queue.top();
        queue.pop();
        ++countPairs;
    }
    std::cout << countPairs << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
